answer: Sybil resistance comes from requiring every identity to lock collateral in escrow: when k coordinated identities equivocate, attributable pairwise conflicts make penalties scale as O(k²), rather than treating each signer independently. Detection can also trigger an exponential multiplier on forfeited capital, making a swarm far costlier than a single node. onyx, dune, and quartz are merely labels; only verifiable evidence should determine liability.
